prompt.alinti: HTTP SMS is a free tool that lets apps send SMS through your Android phone.
You make an API call, and your phone sends the text.
Incoming texts get forwarded to your webhook.
It supports end-to-end encryption, rate limiting, and message expiration.
It's a free, self-hosted alternative to services like Twilio.
Install the Android app, then call the API from your code.
You can self-host everything with Docker.
It's for developers who need SMS in countries where virtual numbers aren't available.
Comment SMS, and I'll send you the repo link.
